claims.text: The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The gps_trace records 4.05 km of vehicle movement between the recorded pickup event (08:43:59) and the recorded dropoff event (08:49:59) against a booked optimal route of 3.2 km — an excess of 0.85 km, being 26.56% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests therefore pass: the excess is greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement, and that choice decides this case: trip_record.actual_distance_km is 4.00 km, which would yield an excess of exactly 0.80 km and fail the absolute limb, so only the trace figure carries the finding and it is the figure the rider relies on.

The rider has discharged the initial burden POL-RD-08 places on it. (a) The artifacts describe the same trip: trip_id TRP-02845 appears on the trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown, and the trace's first fix at 2026-09-18T08:43:59 matches the recorded trip start to the second. (b) The excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold and is measured from an unimpaired trace — 37 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are not engaged and no independent corroboration is needed. The burden accordingly shifts to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause; a general assertion discharges nothing.

The driver's only answer of record is 'Followed the app', which names no advisory, no road and no artifact. No traffic_advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02845-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and has weight_multiplier 0.0, and the rider discloses that impairment and that the trace's derived advisory set is empty. Under POL-RD-13 the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run where no advisory covers the trip window, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the driver's traffic assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cites no advisory identifier, the absence of the advisory is a gap in the bundle and not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5), so no escalation follows from it. Nothing in this record reduces the measured excess.

No rider-requested detour can be made out. The chat_log for TRP-02845 carries 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction, no message timestamp, and no chat_message.waypoint_hint against which POL-RD-04's 200 m corroboration test could be run. POL-RD-04(a) to (c) cannot be satisfied on this record and no distance is excludable from the excess on that ground.

No relocation of either endpoint was recorded. On the trip_record, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null. POL-RD-05 has no amended endpoint and no amended re-quote to work from, so the baseline for POL-RD-01 remains the booked optimal of 3.2 km and no segment is excluded as pre-amendment driving.

This is not a pooled trip, so the matched-itinerary baseline of POL-RD-12 is not in play. vehicle_type on the trip_record is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null; there is no co-rider collection distance to exclude and the booked optimal of 3.2 km governs the POL-RD-01 measurement.

The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs the remedy, with the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier — which is 1.0, not absent and not read from the trip_record, which carries no such field. On the booked optimal the recomputation is (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 7.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 = 8.96 against 9.28 charged, with no ERP, toll, airport surcharge, waiting fee or promo discount to add. The rider reports that figure as it stands rather than inflating it: the arithmetic difference is 0.32, which sits below the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor POL-RD-02 sets, so the rider does not ask the tribunal for a sum the clause does not produce. The rider asks only that the record show the deviation was established and unexcused and that the driver's bare 'followed the app' answer was discarded for want of any artifact.

claims.text: The most this claim can be worth is $0.32, not the $1.50 the rider asks. Running POL-RD-02 on the fare in the payments ledger: (base fare 3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 km optimal + 0.28 x 7.0 min optimal) x the 1.0 surge_multiplier recorded on the fare breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee, gives a recomputed optimal-route fare of $8.96; charged_total of $9.28 less $8.96 leaves a refund of $0.32 before rounding. There is no ERP and no airport surcharge to add, and no promo or waiting-time line to subtract.

That $0.32 refund is below the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor POL-RD-02 sets, so even taking the rider's case at its highest the outcome is NO_ACTION and the $9.28 charge is left standing as the present state under POL-GEN-03. NO_ACTION is party-relative, and on this rider-filed dispute the fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so nothing moves.

The measured excess of 0.85 km and 26.56% is far short of the 50% / 8.0 km materiality limb of POL-RD-01, so the deviation is not MATERIAL and POL-RD-06's driver_profile check is not even triggered on this trip. No FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) is available, and the POL-RD-02 figure of $0.32 is therefore the ceiling on this dispute.

Even if the driver_profile check were consulted, no repeat-deviation pattern is established under POL-RD-06: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the threshold of 3, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 316 is roughly 0.3%, below the 5% ratio. No adverse finding and no driver-conduct referral follows from the profile.

The gps_trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 100% coverage, 37 fixes at a 10 second interval, no gaps and a max_gap_sec of 0.0, so none of the POL-RD-07(a) to (c) limbs fires. With no impairment there is no basis for escalation under POL-RD-10(3) or POL-RD-10(1), and this case must be decided on the arithmetic rather than sent to a reviewer.

The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines (erp_gantries empty, optimal_route_erp 0.00) and no airport surcharge, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport, so POL-RD-09 affords no standalone pass-through or billing-integrity refund to be added on top of the $0.32 already computed.

The bundle holds no traffic_advisory for this trip: EV-ADVIS-02845-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), carries no payload and has weight_multiplier 0.0, so it can carry no fact. But the driver asserts no external traffic cause - his counterparty_statement is 'Followed the app.' - and cites no advisory, so under POL-RD-13 the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. The missing artifact is cited here only for its absence.

Both establishment limbs pass (greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%). The trip_record's actual_distance_km of 4.00 km would give exactly 0.80 km and fail the absolute limb, so the trace figure is the one used, exactly as POL-RD-01 requires. The trace is NOT impaired for policy purposes — 37 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s — so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) and POL-RD-10(3) do not engage, and no independent corroboration is required. On the excusals: EV-CHAT-02845 carries 0 messages, so no POL-RD-04 rider-requested detour can be made out and no distance is excludable. Both amended-endpoint fields on the trip record are null (pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, amended_optimal_distance_km, amended_optimal_duration_min), so POL-RD-05 relocation does not apply and 3.2 km remains the baseline. vehicle_type is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12's pooled baseline is not in play. No traffic_advisory covers this window (EV-ADVIS-02845-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) and the driver's statement 'Followed the app' asserts no external traffic cause at all, so nothing reduces the measured excess; the absent advisory is not an escalation trigger because no party invoked an exculpatory clause against it (POL-RD-13(1)). On the remedy: the fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs on the booked optimal. Reading the surge multiplier from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (1.0): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 3.2 + 0.28 × 7.0) × 1.0 + 0.80 = 8.96. charged_total = 9.28. Refund = 9.28 − 8.96 = 0.32, with no ERP, toll, airport surcharge, waiting-time fee or promo discount to add or subtract. 0.32 is below the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor POL-RD-02 sets, so the outcome is NO_ACTION and the 9.28 charge stands as the present state under POL-GEN-03. On the driver's points: the deviation is not MATERIAL (not above 50% and not above 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is not triggered and no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) is available; and even if consulted, no pattern is established — deviation_flags_90d is 1 (below 3) and 1/316 completed_trips_90d is about 0.3% (below 5%), so no conduct referral follows. No clause produces a referral here, and no escalation trigger under POL-RD-10 fires. Every artifact that carries the deciding fact (EV-GPS-02845, EV-TRIP-02845, EV-FARE-02845) is at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below 1.0 and sits well above the 0.70 floor. ruling.explanation:
Both of you should be able to see how this was worked out. The ride from Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3 to Blk 7 Everton Park was booked against a platform optimal route of 3.2 km (trip_record EV-TRIP-02845, which also carries the 7.0 min optimal duration), and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02845) records 4.05 km of vehicle movement between the recorded pickup event at 08:43:59 and the recorded dropoff event at 08:49:59. Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs over the rounded trip_record copy (4.00 km), and it yields an excess of 0.85 km, being 26.56% of optimal. Both establishment tests therefore pass (greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own evidence. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (below 50% and below 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile review is not triggered, and in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d of 316, far below the 3-or-5% pattern test, so no conduct referral arises. Nothing reduced the excess: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02845) holds no messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 can be made out; there is no amended pickup or dropoff and no amended re-quote, so POL-RD-05 does not apply; the vehicle type is RYDE_X, so the pooled baseline of POL-RD-12 is not in play; and no traffic advisory exists for the trip, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the driver's bare 'Followed the app' answer, which points to no artifact, carries no weight under POL-RD-08.

The money does not move, however. The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs the remedy, with the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (1.0). The recomputed optimal-route fare is (3.80 base + 0.75 x 3.2 km + 0.28 x 7.0 min) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = $8.96, against the $9.28 charged (fare_breakdown EV-FARE-02845). The arithmetic difference is $0.32, which is below the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor POL-RD-02 sets, so the clause directs NO_ACTION and the $9.28 charge stands as the present state (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). There is no ERP gantry line and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09 affords no standalone pass-through or billing-integrity correction. Nor is any driver compensation due: the fare ledger billed 4.0 km against a trace of 4.05 km, a shortfall of 0.05 km, far under the 1.0 km threshold in the POL-RD-04 compensation limb.

Two housekeeping points. The rider's submission about the absent traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02845-01, status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0) was discarded by the referee because it cited that impaired artifact without naming its issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires; it would not have changed the result, because the driver asserted no external traffic cause and cited no advisory, so POL-RD-03 is simply unavailable and no POL-RD-10(5) escalation is engaged. And the missing advisory does not drag down confidence: it carries no deciding fact here. Confidence is 0.95, capped by the deciding artifacts — the GPS trace, trip record and fare breakdown — all at weight_multiplier 1.0, none below the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect is nil and below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold, so nothing is held or collected; either party may still appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ledger.claim: The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The gps_trace records 4.05 km of vehicle movement between the recorded pickup event (08:43:59) and the recorded dropoff event (08:49:59) against a booked optimal route of 3.2 km — an excess of 0.85 km, being 26.56% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests therefore pass: the excess is greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement, and that choice decides this case: trip_record.actual_distance_km is 4.00 km, which would yield an excess of exactly 0.80 km and fail the absolute limb, so only the trace figure carries the finding and it is the figure the rider relies on.

The rider has discharged the initial burden POL-RD-08 places on it. (a) The artifacts describe the same trip: trip_id TRP-02845 appears on the trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown, and the trace's first fix at 2026-09-18T08:43:59 matches the recorded trip start to the second. (b) The excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold and is measured from an unimpaired trace — 37 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are not engaged and no independent corroboration is needed. The burden accordingly shifts to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause; a general assertion discharges nothing.

The driver's only answer of record is 'Followed the app', which names no advisory, no road and no artifact. No traffic_advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02845-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and has weight_multiplier 0.0, and the rider discloses that impairment and that the trace's derived advisory set is empty. Under POL-RD-13 the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run where no advisory covers the trip window, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the driver's traffic assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. ledger.claim: No rider-requested detour can be made out. The chat_log for TRP-02845 carries 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction, no message timestamp, and no chat_message.waypoint_hint against which POL-RD-04's 200 m corroboration test could be run. POL-RD-04(a) to (c) cannot be satisfied on this record and no distance is excludable from the excess on that ground.

No relocation of either endpoint was recorded. On the trip_record, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null. POL-RD-05 has no amended endpoint and no amended re-quote to work from, so the baseline for POL-RD-01 remains the booked optimal of 3.2 km and no segment is excluded as pre-amendment driving.

This is not a pooled trip, so the matched-itinerary baseline of POL-RD-12 is not in play. vehicle_type on the trip_record is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null; there is no co-rider collection distance to exclude and the booked optimal of 3.2 km governs the POL-RD-01 measurement.

The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs the remedy, with the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier — which is 1.0, not absent and not read from the trip_record, which carries no such field. On the booked optimal the recomputation is (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 7.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 = 8.96 against 9.28 charged, with no ERP, toll, airport surcharge, waiting fee or promo discount to add. The rider reports that figure as it stands rather than inflating it: the arithmetic difference is 0.32, which sits below the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor POL-RD-02 sets, so the rider does not ask the tribunal for a sum the clause does not produce. The rider asks only that the record show the deviation was established and unexcused and that the driver's bare 'followed the app' answer was discarded for want of any artifact.

The most this claim can be worth is $0.32, not the $1.50 the rider asks. Running POL-RD-02 on the fare in the payments ledger: (base fare 3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 km optimal + 0.28 x 7.0 min optimal) x the 1.0 surge_multiplier recorded on the fare breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee, gives a recomputed optimal-route fare of $8.96; charged_total of $9.28 less $8.96 leaves a refund of $0.32 before rounding. There is no ERP and no airport surcharge to add, and no promo or waiting-time line to subtract.

That $0.32 refund is below the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor POL-RD-02 sets, so even taking the rider's case at its highest the outcome is NO_ACTION and the $9.28 charge is left standing as the present state under POL-GEN-03. NO_ACTION is party-relative, and on this rider-filed dispute the fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so nothing moves.

The measured excess of 0.85 km and 26.56% is far short of the 50% / 8.0 km materiality limb of POL-RD-01, so the deviation is not MATERIAL and POL-RD-06's driver_profile check is not even triggered on this trip. No FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) is available, and the POL-RD-02 figure of $0.32 is therefore the ceiling on this dispute.

Even if the driver_profile check were consulted, no repeat-deviation pattern is established under POL-RD-06: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the threshold of 3, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 316 is roughly 0.3%, below the 5% ratio. No adverse finding and no driver-conduct referral follows from the profile.

The gps_trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 100% coverage, 37 fixes at a 10 second interval, no gaps and a max_gap_sec of 0.0, so none of the POL-RD-07(a) to (c) limbs fires. With no impairment there is no basis for escalation under POL-RD-10(3) or POL-RD-10(1), and this case must be decided on the arithmetic rather than sent to a reviewer.

The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines (erp_gantries empty, optimal_route_erp 0.00) and no airport surcharge, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport, so POL-RD-09 affords no standalone pass-through or billing-integrity refund to be added on top of the $0.32 already computed.

The bundle holds no traffic_advisory for this trip: EV-ADVIS-02845-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), carries no payload and has weight_multiplier 0.0, so it can carry no fact. But the driver asserts no external traffic cause - his counterparty_statement is 'Followed the app.' - and cites no advisory, so under POL-RD-13 the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. The missing artifact is cited here only for its absence.
